title: Code Red
description: Zara faces a major setback during her first 24-hour hackathon, forcing her to ask for help.

scenes.narration: At hour twenty of my first hackathon, my entire project crashed, wiping out thousands of lines of code.
scenes.visual: Teen girl staring at a glowing laptop screen with a shocked and tired expression

scenes.narration: I had spent the whole night working alone because I wanted to prove I didn't need anyone's help to win.
scenes.visual: Overhead view of a messy desk with energy drinks and a glowing laptop in a dark room

scenes.narration: With only four hours left until judging, tears stung my eyes. I was ready to pack up my bag and quit.
scenes.visual: Teen girl leaning back in a chair rubbing her eyes in exhaustion

scenes.narration: A teammate from across the table noticed my panic and pulled up a chair without asking questions.
scenes.visual: Two teens sitting together in front of a laptop discussing code intensely

scenes.narration: Together, we found a backup file from midnight and rebuilt the broken interface step by step.
scenes.visual: Close-up of hands typing rapidly on an illuminated keyboard in a dim room

scenes.narration: We didn't take first place, but presenting our working app together was a bigger win than I expected.
scenes.visual: Two teens high-fiving across a desk in a brightly lit modern hall

scenes.narration: Asking for help isn't weakness, it's how we grow stronger. Follow along for daily stories of real growth!
scenes.visual: Teen girl standing confidently in a brightly lit hallway smiling at the camera

character_reference: A young human woman with a slender build, messy dark brown hair tied in a loose high bun, wearing an oversized charcoal-grey hoodie and dark blue jeans. She features round black-rimmed eyeglasses and a blue event lanyard around her neck.
